text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, at my usual reptile café—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A green iguana and an African spurred 
tortoise... Heh. Just looking at these 
little ones puts my heart at ease...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but look at the time. Thank you for 
this brief moment of solace—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Heart-san! If you'd like, would you 
want to pet the newcomer?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! A ball python! And it's an albino! 
How beautiful... I'm so moved."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's the matter? Staring like 
that... Have you never seen an Umamusume 
before?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, it's wrapping around my hand! 
Hehe! It feels just like getting a hug 
from Papa...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I-If you do something like this for me, 
how am I supposed to leave...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, after playing to her heart's 
content with the snake, Daring Heart ended 
up skipping training.
